customer: Hello, I'm planning to sell my cargo van to Northwind Auto, and since I commute a long way for work, I'd rather not make an extra trip just to pick up a payment. Could you tell me what my options are for getting paid once everything is signed? I also still have a loan on the van, so I'd appreciate knowing how that part works. Thank you!
agent: Thank you for reaching out! Per our article "When and how you get paid," once the paperwork is signed we can pay you by bank draft at the store, by direct deposit (1 to 3 business days), or by a check mailed to your address (5 to 7 business days), so direct deposit or a mailed check would save you a trip. Since there's a loan on your van, we'll send the payoff to your lender within 2 business days, and you'll receive the amount left over. Please keep making your loan payments until your lender confirms the payoff.
